d: Immerse yourself in the timeless beauty of Indian classical music as the gifted sitar virtuoso Roopa Panesar performs Raag Miyan Ki Malhar at the Darbar Festival 2021. Steeped in centuries of tradition, this powerful monsoon raga evokes the deep rumblings of thunderclouds and the soulful yearning for rain, brought vividly to life through Roopa's masterful touch and emotional depth. Filmed in the serene ambience of the Darbar stage, this performance is a rare gem that bridges ancient ragas with a contemporary audience. Settle in, close your eyes, and let the magic of the Malhar tradition…
